CombinedHeatandPowerSystemModelDevelopment CHP systems generate on-site electricity and reuse waste heat to supply heating or cooling demand with steam. Therefore, CHP systems are efficient, achieving overall efficiencies between 65% and 80%. They are 30% to 70% more efficient than traditional separate on- site heat generation and grid power [32]. In large-scale district energy applications, the new CHPmodelmustsatisfytwokeyrequirements.
